sentences.en: Management is able to use the growth to entice and encourage employees.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: When an organisation is shrinking, the best and most mobile workers are prone to leave voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 当一个组织正在缩小时,最佳和最机动的工人很容易自愿离开。

sentences.en: Unfortunately, they are the ones the organisation can least afford to losethose with the highest skills and experience.

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The minor employees remain because their job options are limited.

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句

sentences.en: Morale also suffers during decline.
sentences.zh: 士气下降期间也受到影响。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: People fear they may be the next to be made redundant.

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Productivity often suffers, as employees spend their time sharing rumours and providing one another with moral support rather than focusing on their jobs.
sentences.zh: 生产力往往受到损害,因为雇员花时间分享谣言,相互提供道义支持,而不是专注于工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For those whose jobs are secure, pay increases are rarely possible.
sentences.zh: 对于工作有保障的人来说,增加工资是很少可能的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Pay cuts, unheard of during times of growth, may even be imposed.
sentences.zh: 甚至在增长时期从未听说过的减薪甚至可能被强制实行。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: The challenge to management is how to motivate employees under such retrenchment conditions.
sentences.zh: 管理层面临的挑战是如何在这种裁员条件下激励雇员。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The ways of meeting this challenge can be broadly divided into six Key Points, which are outlined below.
sentences.zh: 迎接这一挑战的方法大致可分为六个要点,概述如下。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

words.def: 会议会议会议会议会议会议会议会议会议会议

sentences.en: KEY POINT ONE There is an abundance of evidence to support the motivational benefits that result from carefully matching people to jobs.
sentences.zh: 重点一:有大量证据支持通过仔细地将人与工作匹配起来而带来的激励性好处。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For example, if the job is running a small business or an autonomous unit within a larger business, high achievers should be sought.
sentences.zh: 例如,如果该工作经营小企业或在大型企业内自主单位,应寻求高成就者。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: However, if the job to be filled is a managerial post in a large bureaucratic organisation, a candidate who has a high need for power and a low need for affiliation should be selected.
sentences.zh: 但是,如果拟填补的职位是一个大型官僚组织的管理职位,那么,应挑选一个非常需要权力和对附属关系需求低的候选人。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Accordingly, high achievers should not be put into jobs that are inconsistent with their needs.
sentences.zh: 因此,不应让高成就者从事与其需求不符的工作。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: High achievers will do best when the job provides moderately challenging goals and where there is independence and feedback.
sentences.zh: 当工作提供具有适度挑战性的目标,并且有独立性和反馈,高成就者将发挥最大作用。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: However, it should be remembered that not everybody is motivated by jobs that are high in independence, variety and responsibility.
sentences.zh: 然而,应当记住,并非每个人都受到独立、多样化和负责程度高的工作的驱动。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: KEY POINT TWO The literature on goal-setting theory suggests that managers should ensure that all employees have specific goals and receive comments on how well they are doing in those goals.
sentences.zh: 关于制定目标理论的文献表明,管理人员应确保所有雇员都有具体目标,并接受关于他们在这些目标方面做得如何的评论。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: For those with high achievement needs, typically a minority in any organisation, the existence of external goals is less important because high achievers are already internally motivated.
sentences.zh: 对于那些具有高成就需求的人,通常是任何组织中的少数,外部目标的存在并不重要,因为高成就者已经出于内部动机。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: The next factor to be determined is whether the goals should be assigned by a manager or collectively set in conjunction with the employees.
sentences.zh: 下一个有待确定的因素是目标应由管理人员指定,还是由雇员共同设定。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The answer to that depends on perceptions the culture, however, goals should be assigned.
sentences.zh: 然而,要解决这个问题,取决于文化的观念,应该确定目标。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: If participation and the culture are incongruous, employees are likely to perceive the participation process as manipulative and be negatively affected by it.
sentences.zh: 如果参与和文化不协调,雇员就可能认为参与过程是操纵性的,并受到其负面影响。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: KEY POINT THREE Regardless of whether goals are achievable or well within management’s perceptions of the employee’s ability, if employees see them as unachievable they will reduce their effort.
sentences.zh: 关键点三:无论目标是可实现的,还是管理层对雇员能力的看法完全可以实现,如果雇员认为目标无法实现,那么他们就会减少自己的努力。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Managers must be sure, therefore, that employees feel confident that their efforts can lead to performance goals.
sentences.zh: 因此,管理人员必须确信,雇员相信他们的努力能够导致业绩目标。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: For managers, this means that employees must have the capability of doing the job and must regard the appraisal process as valid.
sentences.zh: 对管理人员来说,这意味着雇员必须有能力从事这项工作,而且必须认为评估程序是有效的。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: KEY POINT FOUR Since employees have different needs, what acts as a reinforcement for one may not for another.
sentences.zh: 关键点四由于雇员有不同的需要,什么是作为一种补充,对另一种可能不是。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Managers could use their knowledge of each employee to personalise the rewards over which they have control.
sentences.zh: 管理人员可以利用他们对每个雇员的了解,使他们掌握的奖励具有个性化。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some of the more obvious rewards that managers allocate include pay, promotions, autonomy, job scope and depth, and the opportunity to participate in goal-setting and decision-making.
sentences.zh: 管理人员分配的一些更明显的奖励包括薪酬、晋升、自主、工作范围和深度,以及参与目标制定和决策的机会。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: KEY POINT FIVE Managers need to make rewards contingent on performance.
sentences.zh: 关键五级管理人员需要根据业绩给予奖励。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: To reward factors other than performance will only reinforce those other factors.
sentences.zh: 奖励业绩以外的因素只会加强这些其他因素。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Key rewards such as pay increases and promotions or advancements should be allocated for the attainment of the employee’s specific goals.
sentences.zh: 为实现雇员的具体目标,应分配诸如加薪、晋升或晋升等关键奖励。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: Consistent with maximising the impact of rewards, managers should look for ways to increase their visibility.
sentences.zh: 管理人员应设法提高他们的知名度,以符合奖励影响最大化的做法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Eliminating the secrecy surrounding pay by openly communicating everyone’s remuneration, publicising performance bonuses and allocating annual salary increases in a lump sum rather than spreading them out over an entire year are examples of actions that will make rewards more visible and potentially more motivating.
sentences.zh: 公开宣传每个人的薪酬、公布业绩奖金和一次性分配年薪加薪,而不是将年薪调涨到全年,以此消除薪酬的保密性,这些例子将使人们更加能看到奖励,并有可能增加奖励的积极性。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: KEY POINT SIX The way rewards are distributed should be transparent so that employees perceive that rewards or outcomes are equitable and equal to the inputs given.
sentences.zh: 奖励的分配方式应当透明,使雇员认为奖励或结果是公平的,与投入平等。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: On a simplistic level, experience, abilities, effort and other obvious inputs should explain differences in pay, responsibility and other obvious outcomes.
sentences.zh: 在简单化的层面上,经验、能力、努力和其他明显投入应当解释薪资、责任和其他明显结果的差异。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The problem, however, is complicated by the existence of dozens of inputs and outcomes and by the fact that employee groups place different degrees of importance on them.
sentences.zh: 然而,由于存在数十种投入和结果,以及雇员团体对之的重视程度不同,这一问题变得更加复杂。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: For instance, a study comparing clerical and production workers identified nearly twenty inputs and outcomes.
sentences.zh: 例如,一项比较文书和生产工人的研究确定了近20项投入和成果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: The clerical workers considered factors such as quality of work performed and job knowledge near the top of their list, but these were at the bottom of the production workers’ list.
sentences.zh: 文书工们考虑了诸如工作质量和工作知识等基本因素,但是这些因素在生产工人名单中排在最前面。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Similarly, production workers thought that the most important inputs were intelligence and personal involvement with task accomplishment, two factors that were quite low in the importance ratings of the clerks.
sentences.zh: 同样,生产工人认为最重要的投入是情报和个人参与完成任务,这两个因素在办事员的重要评级方面相当低。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: There were also important, though less dramatic, differences on the outcome side.
sentences.zh: 结果方面也存在着重要但不太剧烈的分歧。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: For example, production workers rated advancement very highly, whereas clerical workers rated advancement in the lower third of their list.
sentences.zh: 例如,生产工人对进步的评价很高,而文书工人则在排名排名排名排名排名排名排名第三的较低者。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Such findings suggest that one person’s equity is another’s inequity, so an ideal should probably weigh different inputs and outcomes according to employee group.
sentences.zh: 此类调查结果表明,一个人的公平是另一个人的不公平,因此理想应该根据雇员群体来权衡不同的投入和结果。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

questions.title: Questions 14-27
instructions: Questions 25-27: Match each group with the correct description.

items.prompt: A shrinking organization tends to lose its less skilled employees rather than its more skilled employees.
It is easier to manage a small business than a large business.
High achievers are well suited to team work.
Some employees can feel manipulated when asked to participate in goal-setting.
The staff appraisal process should be designed by employees.
Employees‟ earnings should be disclosed to everyone within the organization.
